text: なかまから　れんらくが　きたぞ　こんな　ガキが　サカキさまの　しりあいな　わけ　ねえだろが！

structure.jp: なかまから　れんらくが　きたぞ
サカキさまの　しりあいな　わけ　ねえだろが！
structure.en: can't possibly be an acquaintance of Giovanni's!

patterns.name: 〜わけがない
patterns.span: しりあいな　わけ　ねえ
patterns.explanation: わけがない means 'there is no way that is true'. Here が is dropped and ない is said roughly as ねえ. しりあいな　わけ　ねえ = 'no way (he's) an acquaintance'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is short for だろう, 'surely, right?', and the が tacked on makes it angry. わけ　ねえだろが = 'there's obviously no way!'

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way of announcing something, used mostly by men. れんらくが　きたぞ = 'I got word!'
